findings.question: q-biology-meiosis-and-genetic-variation-0008
findings.quote: This is the genotype of the parent cell. The question asks for gametes, and a gamete is haploid. Check that a gamete does not carry both alleles of a gene.
findings.problem: The note for $AaBb$ identifies the mistake and gives a check, but does not explain why the choice looks right. For example, a student may think each gamete must retain all the parent's alleles to pass both genes to offspring. This is the same missing component identified in round 1 for the $AaBb$ note in question 0007.
findings.fix: Add that keeping all the parent's alleles may seem necessary to pass on both genes.
